topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Rain's been coming down like it's trying to wash the city away. Got a call from a dame whose ride's been scooped up from her own damn driveway. Like I need more mysteries in my life. But when the money's as thin as the chance of a clear sky, you don't ask questions, you just get moving. The way she talked, you'd think it was a matter of life and death. Maybe for her, it is. People get desperate, you know? I'm not in the business of judgment, just in the business of sorting out the messes they leave behind. Set out at first light, but the night’s not done with me yet. Something tells me, this is just the start.
